_comment: Source entries the EventbriteSearch.Tests.ps1 tests read by name. Test data only: these are not running sources.

sources.name: eventbrite-lyons
sources.notes: Eventbrite's browse page for Lyons. robots.txt does not disallow /d/ or /e/ pages (checked 2026-11-05). The page's window.__SERVER_DATA__ has buckets[].events[] with start and end in America/Denver, and each event's own page has schema.org offers with the price. On 2026-11-05 it listed 16 events: 8 online with no address, and 8 around the county (Longmont, Niwot, Lafayette, Louisville, Broomfield, Boulder), none in Lyons itself. No second page. Each kept event's page is read once a run for its price. Configured 2026-11-05. Terms not read 2026-11-10: HTTP 405 from GitHub's servers every night (never fetched there); loads from a home connection (200), so it is local.
